name: arrange-in-eight-lines
title: arrange in eight lines
description: One 4-bar section played eight times while the arrange rewrites its patterns: `~` changes a part from here on, `@` for the next section only. The smallest arrange that moves, with three comments that teach it.

name: arrange-mutations
title: arrange mutations
description: An arrangement that rewrites its own patterns as it goes. `~` changes a pattern from there on, `@` for the next section only, a glob drifts every acid line. Four evolving passes, then an outro read with the last generation.

name: hand-dubstep-140-v4
title: hand-dubstep 140, v4
description: A whole dubstep track in one program: nine sections from intro to outro. The v2, v3, v4 line adds accents, slides, seeded humanize, every(), a half-time and a slam section; a riser leads into each drop and a wobble bass sits under a once-a-bar filter.

name: matrix-130
title: matrix 130
description: A D-phrygian driving track in eight sections with generated arps and an evolve that settles into a cycle. Seeded degrade, defs, a riser into the climax.

name: trance-138
title: trance 138
description: A 64-bar trance track (intro 16, breakdown 16, drop 24, outro 8) said once with lets, two defs, four sections and an arrange. The same song written longhand has the same net CIDs.

name: hand-dubstep-140-v2
title: hand-dubstep 140, v2
description: The first whole-track dubstep program, and the shortest one here: six sections in 64 bars. A riser opens over eight bars and lands on the drop; a wobble-lead bass sits under a filter that opens and shuts once a bar.

name: markers-demo
title: markers demo
description: A 24-bar program that lights up every kind of marker in the editor. A def, a repeat of filter ramps, an evolve with a stop, a timed control line, sections and an arrange.

name: first-beat
title: first beat
description: A four-line beat: tempo, drums on deck A, bass and a pad on deck B, and an end. Start here to see what a deck line is.

name: acid-line
title: acid line
description: A squelchy FM bass line with an accent (!) and a slide (^), a kick and hats, and a filter cutoff and resonance that ramp over 16 bars. Shows let, accents, slides and ramps.

name: evolve-demo
title: evolve demo
description: A program that changes itself: every 4 bars the melody rotates and climbs and the hi-hat thins out, until generation 7. Shows evolve, rotate, transpose with per-generation values, thin and a stop bound.

name: vocals
title: vocals
description: Lyrics that read like code: words through the lexicon, phonemes between slashes, two phrases from the phrasebook, the vocoder fading in on deck A. A held and an accented syllable, then the vocoder hands off.

name: trap-expression
title: trap expression
description: A short trap beat written with the expression marks: ratchet rolls (x:3, x:4) and ghosts (x.) on the hats, a snare flam (x&) every other bar. The 808 sub has a long decay, a pitch-drop punch on every note and glides (^, glide=70).

name: pattern-sugar
title: pattern sugar
description: A 24-bar groove written with pattern sugar: c2~3 elongate, a bare x? (x?0.5), ply, poly, off, iter and palindrome. Each is written out before it plays, so it is the same song as its longhand.

name: such-stuff-as-dreams-122
title: such stuff as dreams, 122
description: A phrase compiled to a track: one line, template(deep-house, @tempest_such_stuff), is deep house at 122 whose vocal line is Shakespeare's verse. Its twenty iambic syllables sit on the beats with the stressed ones accented; the voice is buried in `night` and spotlit in `spot`, an octave up, then crossed onto the shaker.

name: assyrian-122
title: the Assyrian, 122
description: The same deep house over an anapestic line: Byron's "The Assyrian came down like the wolf on the fold" has the triplet feel, so the voice and the shaker go in a 12-step cycle, three syllables to the beat against the four-on-the-floor kick.

name: commit-message-122
title: a commit message, 122
description: Any words are a phrase: a commit message, make the drop deeper and move the kick, has its stress worked out (small words weak, the first syllable of the rest strong) and becomes a two-bar vocal line on the same deep house.
